method.sample_filter: pair >= 0; all 200 per selected cell; five warmups excluded
method.paired_delta: candidate minus baseline within the existing randomized pair
method.quartiles: four contiguous 50-pair blocks sorted by pair start time
method.order: stratify by which binary executed first, without exclusion or reweighting
method.temporal_descriptors: Spearman rank correlation of pair start time vs log(candidate metric/baseline metric); Pearson lag-1 of the same log ratios
method.inference: No confidence intervals, resampling, significance tests, gate revisions or new admission; medians are not additive
method.counter_scope: Optional retained time(1) process counters cover the whole process, including phases and emission, not a render-stage attribution
